newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR SWEDEN-SCOTLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR SWEDEN-SCOTLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's World Cup qualifier between Sweden and Scotland.

Sweden - 1-Thomas Ravelli; 2-Gary Sundgren, 3-Patrik Andersson, 4-Joachim Bjrklund, 5-Pontus Kamark; 9-Jonas Thern, 7-Per Zetterberg, 6-Stefan Schwarz; 8-Andreas Andersson, 11-Kennet Andersson, 10-Martin Dahlin.
Scotland 1-Jim Leighton; 3-Tom Boyd, 2-Craig Burley, 4-Colin Calderwood, 5-Colin Hendry; 6-Tosh McKinlay, 8-Paul Lambert, 10-Gary McAllister; 11-John Collins 7-Kevin Gallacher, 9-Darren Jackson.
